title: I had to walk
goal: Say what you had to, have to and will have to do with -mAlY and bolmak.

intro.text: `-mAlY` has no past of its own. Add *bolmak* and put *bolmak* in the tense you need: *gitmeli boldum* (I had to go), *gitmeli bolaryn* (I'll have to go), *gitmeli bolýar* (she has to go, regularly). *bolmak* carries the ending.

vocab.en: to repair, to fix; to treat (an illness)

exercises.question: How do you say **I had to wait**?

why.1: *bolýaryn* is the present: **I have to wait** (these days).
why.3: The ending goes on *bolmak*, and `-mAlY` stays as it is: *garaşmaly boldum*.

exercises.explain: *garaşmaly* + *boldum*, the past of *bolmak*: I had to wait.

reject.why: After *o* in the first syllable, the second syllable rounds: *bolduk*.

exercises.label: *gitmeli* + *bolmak* in the past: I had to go, you had to go… (type the form of *bolmak*)
exercises.explain: *gitmeli* stays as it is; *bolmak* takes the past and the person: *gitmeli boldum, gitmeli bolduň…*

exercises.prompt: Dükan ýapykdy, şonuň üçin bazara gitmeli boldum.
accept: The shop was closed, so I had to go to the market.
The shop was closed, so I needed to go to the market.
The store was closed, so I [had to|needed to] go to the market.
The shop was closed, [that's why|and so] I had to go to the market.

exercises.question: *Ertir ir turmaly bolarys.* What does it say?
options: Tomorrow we'll have to get up early.
Yesterday we had to get up early.
We have to get up early every day.

why.1: That would be *Düýn ir turmaly bolduk*.
why.2: That would be *Her gün ir turmaly bolýarys*.

exercises.explain: *bolarys*, the general present of *bolmak* for **we**: we'll have to.

exercises.prompt: We had to wait for an hour.
exercises.explain: *garaşmaly* + *bolduk*; *bir sagat*, for an hour, needs no ending.
*açyk*, open; **is** isn't written. Its opposite is *ýapyk*.

exercises.en: My father had to repair the car.
exercises.explain: **Had to**: *bejermeli boldy*. `-mAlY` on the verb, the past on *bolmak*.

exercises.prompt: I'll have to repair my phone.

reject.why: *boljak* has no ending, so say who: *Men telefonymy bejermeli boljak*, or use *bolaryn*.

exercises.explain: *bejermeli* + *bolaryn* (I'll have to); **my phone** as an object: *telefonymy*.

exercises.prompt: Ol her gün nobatda durmaly bolýar.
accept: She has to stand in a queue every day.
She has to [stand in line|queue|wait in line|wait in a queue] every day.
He has to [stand in a queue|stand in line|queue|wait in line|wait in a queue] every day.
Every day [he|she] has to [stand in a queue|stand in line|queue|wait in line].

exercises.question: Which sentence means **She has to work every day**?
